lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines of varying intensity; spacing is widest at the mid-torso and compresses significantly toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the third line from the posterior, splitting into a 'Y' shape at approximately mid-lateral height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated segments identified on the lower posterior haunch that do not reach the dorsal ridge; one dashed line segment located mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 7 high-contrast white spots on the lower haunch, arranged in a roughly triangular density pattern above the stifle.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three circular blobs on the lateral thigh forming a semi-linear geometric path.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral flare of approximately 35 degrees from the vertical axis before curving medially and dorsally toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.5 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping is visible and occupies approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a distinct chevron between the eyes and two prominent white spots on the lateral cheek; high-contrast white transverse bands on the lower legs.
